item.title: MCU Rumor Roundup: Ed Harris' WONDER MAN Role, AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Costume Leak, And More
item.description: In our latest MCU rumour roundup, we have news on who will and who won't appear in Wonder Man, along with more details on what some of the X-Men costumes will look like in Avengers: Doomsday. Check it out!

item.title: RUMOR: MAN OF TOMORROW Looking To Cast Actress In Her 20s For Major Role - Could It Be Wonder Woman?
item.description: As Man of Tomorrow starts taking shape at DC Studios, a new rumour points to a young actress in their 20s being sought for a major role. Could this be the DCU's Wonder Woman? Here's what we know so far...

item.title: BLACK ADAM Star Pierce Brosnan Says Doctor Fate Will Appear In MAN OF TOMORROW
item.description: Black Adam star Pierce Brosnan has reflected on starring in the 2022 box office flop, and reveals that he's heard about plans for Doctor Fate to appear in the next Superman movie, Man of Tomorrow...

item.title: #RestoreTheSnyderVerse Trends Again As WBD Reportedly Entertains Bid From... Saudi Arabia’s PIF
item.description: According to a new report, Warner Bros Discovery may be seriously entertaining a $70 billion offer from Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund, which the #RestoreTheSnyderVerse crowd seem very happy about.

item.title: Zack Snyder Shares Picture Of Bruce Wayne’s Incredible Other “Batmobile” In BATMAN V SUPERMAN: DAWN OF JUSTICE
item.description: Zack Snyder took to Instagram to post a photo of Bruce Wayne’s cool second “Batmobile” in Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice and Justice League.

item.title: The Galaxy's Greatest Hunter Preys Upon The World's Greatest Fighters In PREDATOR: BLOODSHED Comic
item.description: Predator: Bloodshed, a five-issue series by writer Jordan Morris and artist Roland Boschi, arrives in February, and we have a first look and details for the comic that's inspired by an MMA tournament...

item.title: New MAN OF TOMORROW Rumor Points To Potential WONDER WOMAN Debut
item.description: According to a new report, a DC Comics superheroine will make her DCU debut in James Gunn's Superman follow-up, and the physical description sounds like it could be Wonder Woman.

item.title: AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH - First Clip With New Teasers & Posters Released As Tickets Go On Sale
item.description: Tickets for James Cameron's Avatar: Fire and Ash are now on sale, and Disney has debuted the first clip from the movie along with some new teasers and a lot of posters...

item.title: IT: WELCOME TO DERRY Episode 4 Reveals Pennywise's Origin; Midseason Trailer Unleashes The Clown- SPOILERS
item.description: In the fourth episode of It: Welcome to Derry, Pennywise the Clown's origin is finally revealed as we learn what happened when he arrived on Earth. A midseason trailer for the show has also been released.

item.title: THE LEGEND OF ZELDA Movie Unveils First Official Look At Benjamin Evan Ainsworth As Link & Bo Bragason's Zelda
item.description: Following some recent set leaks, Nintendo has shared a first official look at the live-action The Legend of Zelda movie, spotlighting stars Bo Bragason as Zelda and Benjamin Evan Ainsworth as Link...
